description:
Once JMAP-x59i.1 lands (jmap-jscalendar-types exists):

1. Add jmap-jscalendar-types = { path = '../crate-jmap-jscalendar-types' } to crate-jmap-tasks-types/Cargo.toml.

2. Optional but recommended: top-level re-export pub use jmap_jscalendar_types::*; (or selective list) in crate-jmap-tasks-types/src/lib.rs so callers can do jmap_tasks_types::Location symmetrically with jmap_calendars_types::Location.

The 13 Sloppy-Value fields in Task / TaskList stay as Option<serde_json::Value> per workspace policy. Typed access is opt-in via from_value.

Blocked-on: JMAP-x59i.1 (jmap-jscalendar-types crate creation).
notes: Closed as duplicate of JMAP-yfpq.4, which was filed during a /do-beads pass that did not first scan for existing children. The path-dep + re-export work landed in commit 7dac829 (refactor(tasks-types): consume jmap-jscalendar-types).
title: Add jmap-jscalendar-types path-dep + re-exports to jmap-tasks-types
